name: i9_10c_dorm_social
steps: lua:if vcListCode~=xyd.error.OK then error('vc10c-list-code-'..tostring(vcListCode)) end if type(vcHouses)~='table' or type(vcHouses[1])~='table' or not vcHouses[1][1] then error('vc10c-list-shape') end if type(vcFuncs)~='table' then error('vc10c-functions') end if vcHouses[1][1].house_type~=xyd.DormType.LOUNGE then error('vc10c-house-type-'..tostring(vcHouses[1][1].house_type)) end if vcHouses[1][1].house_name~='' or vcHouses[1][1].is_hide~=0 or vcHouses[1][1].praise_num~=0 then error('vc10c-initial-social') end

lua:if vcNameCode~=xyd.error.OK then error('vc10c-name-code-'..tostring(vcNameCode)) end if type(vcNameReply)~='table' then error('vc10c-name-reply') end vcDorm:getHouseList({}, function(code,reply) _G.vcListCode=code _G.vcHouses=reply.house_list end)

lua:if vcListCode~=xyd.error.OK then error('vc10c-name-reload-code-'..tostring(vcListCode)) end if vcHouses[1][1].house_name~='vc10c' then error('vc10c-name-persist-'..tostring(vcHouses[1][1].house_name)) end

lua:if vcHideCode~=xyd.error.OK then error('vc10c-hide-code-'..tostring(vcHideCode)) end if type(vcHideReply)~='table' or type(vcHideReply.house_info)~='table' then error('vc10c-hide-reply') end if vcHideReply.house_info.is_hide~=1 then error('vc10c-hide-value-'..tostring(vcHideReply.house_info.is_hide)) end vcDorm:getHouseList({}, function(code,reply) _G.vcListCode=code _G.vcHouses=reply.house_list end)

lua:if vcListCode~=xyd.error.OK then error('vc10c-hide-reload-code-'..tostring(vcListCode)) end if vcHouses[1][1].is_hide~=1 then error('vc10c-hide-persist-'..tostring(vcHouses[1][1].is_hide)) end vcDorm:hideHouse({house_id=vcHouses[1][1].house_id}, function(code,reply) _G.vcHideCode=code _G.vcHideReply=reply end)
lua:if vcHideCode~=xyd.error.OK or vcHideReply.house_info.is_hide~=0 then error('vc10c-unhide-'..tostring(vcHideCode)) end

lua:if vcPraiseCode~=xyd.error.OK then error('vc10c-praise-list-code-'..tostring(vcPraiseCode)) end if type(vcPraiseReply.praise_list)~='table' or type(vcPraiseReply.total_num)~='number' then error('vc10c-praise-list-shape') end if vcPraiseReply.total_num~=0 then error('vc10c-praise-list-total-'..tostring(vcPraiseReply.total_num)) end

lua:if vcCommentCode~=xyd.error.OK then error('vc10c-comment-list-code-'..tostring(vcCommentCode)) end if type(vcCommentReply.best_comments)~='table' or type(vcCommentReply.comment_list)~='table' or type(vcCommentReply.comment_num)~='number' then error('vc10c-comment-list-shape') end if vcCommentReply.comment_num~=0 then error('vc10c-comment-list-total-'..tostring(vcCommentReply.comment_num)) end

lua:if vcRandomCode==nil then error('vc10c-random-callback') end if vcRandomCode==xyd.error.OK then if type(vcRandomReply.house_infos)~='table' or type(vcRandomReply.host_info)~='table' or vcRandomReply.host_info.player_id==nil then error('vc10c-random-shape') end end
note: Stock Dorm model path for 2518/2520/2522/2524 plus the 2519/2521/2523 refusal callbacks on a single provisioned player. CHANGE_NAME persists through a fresh 2512; HIDE toggles and persists is_hide; the praise and comment lists carry their required reply tables; self praise/comment are refused without a client crash; VISIT_RANDOM invokes its stock callback and, when a candidate exists, returns house_infos and host_info. Foreign praise/comment/reaction/delete and paging are proven by the native PostgreSQL tests.
